messages:
frank_support: Escalating MapleCare onboarding -> CS. Account MC-882, ARR ~$410k. Onboarding blocked: repeated mapping errors and intermittent gateway timeouts during bulk patient ingest. Renewal touch in 10 days, customer is concerned about go-live. Need CS to own bridge + comms plan.

frank_support: Quick context: onboarding started 2026-03-15, their migration runs fail ~60% of batches. Errors show mapping_unknown_field and occasional 504 gateway timeouts when load spikes.

frank_support: Example errors pasted:
```
2026-05-12T16:20:03Z ERROR ingest: mapping_error acct=MC-882 field=insurance.policy_number reason="unknown_field"
2026-05-12T16:20:08Z ERROR http: gateway timeout acct=MC-882 code=504 detail="upstream_timeout"
2026-05-12T16:20:10Z WARN auth: 403 insufficient_scope during retry
```

escalation-bot: [incident] Created P1 case INC-2026-345 for MC-882 assigned to customer-success. SLA: 2 business hours for initial outreach.

zoe_cs: On it. Can support attach the last 200 lines and confirm whether customer retried aggressively? I want to host a bridge and include Eng + Support.

frank_support: Logs attached to INC-2026-345. We saw a 4x spike in concurrent jobs when they switched to parallel migrants at 16:18Z. Enabled debug for org: `enable_org_debug MC-882 --ttl=12h`.

naveen_se: Hypothesis: two independent issues: 1) mapping mismatch (their schema includes `insurance.policy_number` which our ingest schema doesn't accept), 2) retries spiking causing upstream timeouts and auth failures due to refresh race. Short-term mitigations: provide a schema mapping sample + validation script, apply a temporary per-org QPS bump for 24h to absorb migration, and do a canary credential rotate. I can apply the QPS bump if CS approves. Runbook: <https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/mapping-and-ingest-triage>

tara_csm: Comms plan proposal: (A) immediate 30m triage call within 90m with eng on the line, (B) during call present mapping guidance and apply mitigations (quota bump + canary rotate), (C) send post-call summary with remediation timeline and action owner, (D) notify Renewals if unresolved after 24h and prepare outreach. I'll draft the customer note and the email template.

zoe_cs: Proposed bridge: 17:00 PT (in ~40m). @naveen_se please join for mapping/rotate steps. @frank_support please gather a minimal failing payload to share on the call. I'll send the calendar and the short status ping.

frank_support: Minimal failing payload (trimmed):
```json
{
  "patient": { "id": "p-001", "name": "J. Doe", "insurance": { "policy_number": 123456 } }
}
```
Note: `insurance.policy_number` is numeric in their payload. Our ingest expects `insurance.policy_number` as string up to 32 chars.

naveen_se: Suggested validator snippet to share on call:
```js
function validatePolicyNumber(value){
  return typeof value === 'string' && /^\w{1,32}$/.test(value);
}
```
Also recommending short-term: `set_org_qps MC-882 --qps=300 --duration=24h` and `grant_org_debug MC-882 --expires=12h` (debug already enabled). If we rotate credentials, do a canary on a single workspace first.

tara_csm: Draft short ping to customer to send now:
"Hi Priya  we see two root causes: a schema mismatch for insurance.policy_number and a spike of parallel retries triggering gateway timeouts. We're scheduling a 30m troubleshooting call at 17:00 PT to walk a corrected payload sample, apply a temporary throughput increase, and perform a canary credential rotate if needed. We'll follow with a summary and next steps. - Tara, CSM"

zoe_cs: Action items before call: 1) frank attach minimal failing batch to case (done), 2) naveen stand by for QPS bump, 3) tara host and include renewals on the post-call summary.

frank_support: QPS bump request approved by CS. Applying: `set_org_qps MC-882 --qps=300 --duration=24h`. Executed.

naveen_se: QPS bump active. Starting canary rotate on workspace `mc-882-test`. Will validate ingest and watch KV/ingest latency. If canary passes, we'll proceed to full rotation after customer sign-off.

tara_csm: Post-call update: canary rotate succeeded, test workspace ingests accepted after converting `policy_number` to string. Applied temp QPS bump. Customer retried 3 failed batches; 2 succeeded, 1 still failing (related to a nested field mismatch we captured). Customer grateful we moved quickly. Next steps I will own: 1) send the post-call email with payload conversion guidance and validator, 2) schedule a technical follow-up with their engineering next Tuesday, 3) monitor health dashboards for 48h and keep Renewals in the loop. If errors persist after 24h we'll prepare a renewal outreach play.

frank_support: Marked INC-2026-345 as P1 and pinged the account exec about potential renewal concession discussion if onboarding delays continue.

naveen_se: Recommend toggle `ingest-mode=throttle` for 48h to reduce retry storms: `set_org_ingest_mode MC-882 --mode=throttle --duration=48h`. Requesting CS approval.

zoe_cs: Approved. Applying throttle now. `set_org_ingest_mode MC-882 --mode=throttle --duration=48h` executed.

tara_csm: Update (post-mitigation): after conversions and throttle, overall failure rate dropped from ~60% -> ~4%. We will keep the P1 open and monitor. I'll post a short root-cause summary into INC-2026-345 and close this thread once stable for 48h. If anything regresses, escalate to Director CS & Eng. :white_check_mark:
